resources.string: Every message is wrapped in a Zcash shielded transaction with our per-message-key ratchet on top. The most private of the three modes. A short Shielded message costs at least 0.00017 ZEC: the Zcash network fee, a 0.00001 ZEC ZChat fee, and 0.00001 ZEC delivered with the message. ZChat\'s fee wallet sees when fees arrive and how many, not who sent them. The server your wallet syncs from sees your IP address when you send. Photo, file and voice-note links travel inside a shielded transaction too; the files themselves go, encrypted, to public file hosts. Once your contact\'s relay key is known, calls are set up over the relays, as in Tunnel and Open.

%1$s moved this chat to %2$s.

In %2$s, every message you send is a shielded Zcash transaction: each costs at least 0.00017 ZEC and confirms on-chain. Calls are still set up over the relays.

Match it, or keep this chat on %3$s? Each side sends in its own mode, so you can stay on %3$s and still read their messages, as long as you're both on ZChat 2.13 or newer. On older versions, %2$s messages don't show until they update.
